clips.title: The story
paras: "Note to William" is an errand undertaken for Gramma Stonefield in southern Elwynn Forest to help two secret lovers from feuding families. By delivering Mildred's message to the apothecary William Pestle in Goldshire, adventurers seek an alchemical solution to unite young Maybell and Tommy Joe.

The Stonefield and Maclure families have lived as neighbors in southern Elwynn Forest for years, yet their bitter feuding has made normal relations impossible. Caught squarely in the middle are young Tommy Joe Stonefield and Maybell Maclure, whose romance must be conducted in utter secrecy. While their parents harbor relentless resentment, Gramma Mildred Stonefield takes pity on the young lovers and seeks an unconventional remedy to unite them.

Believing that mundane persuasion will never sway the feuding families, Gramma Stonefield dispatches a courier north to the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire. Her message seeks out William Pestle, an experienced alchemist and apothecary whom Mildred has known for many years. Taking the missive in hand, William is moved by the plight of Maybell and Tommy Joe, resolving to put his alchemical knowledge to work on their behalf.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I bet William Pestle has a potion to unite our two young lovers!
Here, take this note to William. He's staying at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You have a note from "Gramma" Stonefield, eh? I haven't seen Mildred in years! I wonder what she has to say...

clips.title: Completion
paras: My heart goes out to those two poor souls, Maybell and Tommy Joe. I remember being young and in love, once.
There must be something I can do to help them! Let me think...
